newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Sodra to raise pulp price to $630/tonne.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Sodra to raise pulp price to $630/tonne.

text.p: Swedish forestry company Sodra Cell said on Friday it planned to raise the price of pulp to $630 per tonne in October from the current price of $580.

Speaking to Reuters by telephone, Sodra spokesman Hans Burmeister said: "Next week we will announce a price increase to our customers. Several North American players have already announced pulp price increases and we will follow."
The price increase was for softwood pulp and would go into effect when current contracts expire, effectively from October, Burmeister said.
